semantic.justification: Original associated-character stage of MoveProperties: shallow fixed Western/CJK/CTL traversal, associated versus normal keywords, CJK langfe exception, exact native posture/weight/height reduction, independent bidi/script flags, one-shot run-state reset and StyleDefinition state preservation. The outer writer collects its borrowed effective character items into a temporary native set and releases it after emission. Full MSWord run script/bidi production, complete general-formatting buffers, font identity/charset-to-current-encoding effects, paragraph-marker properties and RTF language/associated-format import remain unverified or unported. The existing font-table callback identifies names; no fake encoding or bidi provider is introduced. Native non-associated OutputCharFontAssoc updates the actual RtfExport current encoding through FontMapExport and checked font charset selection, with original unknown-to-default fallback; associated font output leaves encoding unchanged. Native RunText ignores its supplied charset and delegates RawText/OutString using current export encoding. RTF text uses represented GetSnippet substitutions; style names and hyperlink values use OutString. The font sink receives the original complete font item and association flag and delegates actual OutputCharFontAssoc emission.
